Information Danelectro A faithful re-issue of the Foxx Tone Machine from the early 70's-at an incredible price! Best "octave up" effect around! the Foxx Tone Machine was invented by Steve Ridinger, the current president of the Danelectro/Evets Corp. at age 19!
